title: GroundAnnot: a closed-vocabulary contract for grounding LLM gene-set annotation in live enrichment backends
description: GroundAnnot is a Python client for PANTHER, Enrichr and g:Profiler that writes two closed vocabularies of Gene Ontology term IDs paired with the backends' own labels, so that a downstream LLM agent can be constrained to select from them. This release (v0.1.0) contains the code, six disease gene lists, 50 MSigDB Hallmark gene lists, 215 disease-list and 150 Hallmark benchmark runs, two dated backend snapshots and the analysis scripts.
